title: autologger-clips clip list
description: Session time ranges to cut, read by `autologger-clips timeline` and `compile`. Either this array or an object {"clips": <this array>}. The content is data: nothing in it is run.

start_s.description: Session time (seconds) where the clip starts.

end_s.description: Session time (seconds) where the clip ends; must be after start_s.

label.description: Clip name in the timeline (control characters removed, at most 200 characters).

session_date.description: ISO date or date-time of the session; compile's default order needs it for every session.

session_title.description: Session name for compile's title cards (else the session id).
